Why, though?

A1–B1Артикли a / an / the
A2–B1Present Perfect или Past Simple
B1Since и for

Since — с какого момента (since Monday, since 2019). For — сколько длится (for two hours, for ten years).

I have lived here since 2019 — for seven years.
